paragraph: Japanese cars sell well **overseas**. His large income makes it possible for him to travel **overseas** every year. The president was very serious about your **overseas** assignment.
english: in or to a foreign country
arabicDesc: مثال: مبيعات السيارات اليابانية في الخارج جيدة.

paragraph: To do him justice, he is a **reliable** man. I think she is a serious and **reliable** person. He grew up to be a very **reliable** man.
english: suitable or fit to be relied on

paragraph: The recent advances in medicine are **remarkable**. Moral and physical development are **remarkable** in the youth. It is **remarkable** that he said nothing at all.
english: worthy of remark
arabicDesc: مثال: التطورات الحديثة في الطب مذهلة .

paragraph: He is **worthy** to be captain of our team. His performance was **worthy** of praise. There was nothing **worthy** of remark at the fair.
english: deserving respect or attention
arabicDesc: مثال: إنه جدير بأن يكون قائد فريقنا.

paragraph: The tourist asked for **lodging** for the night. I want to **lodge** a formal complaint. It is possible to **lodge** an appeal.
english: to be firmly fixed in a specified position
arabicDesc: مثال: سال السائح بخصوص المكوث لهذه الليلة .

paragraph: Maybe you should put that **trophy** in the living room. The winning team received a silver **trophy** as prize. Our team hasn't won a **trophy** for years.
english: object rewarding success
arabicDesc: مثال: ربّما عليك وضع هذه الغنيمة في غرفة الجلوس.

paragraph: If the loser smiled the winner will lose the **thrill** of victory. They do it just for the **thrill** of it. I invite you to experience the **thrill** of freedom.
english: a strong feeling of excitement
arabicDesc: مثال: إذا ابتسم المهزوم أفقد المنتصر لذة الفوز.

paragraph: My brain says yes, but my **gut** says no. A hungry heart is worse than a hungry **gut**. My **gut** warned me, yet I brushed it aside.
english: the stomach and intestines; also a feeling you trust

paragraph: He tried to **absorb** as much of the local culture as possible. How does paper **absorb** water? Paper and fabric **absorb** water.
english: to include so that it no longer has separate existence
arabicDesc: مثال: حاول أن يستوعب أكبر قدر من الثقافة المحلية قدر الإمكان.

other.meaning: to endure
to include so that it no longer has separate existence
to suck up or drink in

paragraph: The **emperor** was a hard father with his children. In an empty place, an **emperor** has no power. When the Russian **Emperor** is fishing, Europe may wait.
english: the male monarch or ruler of an empire
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: إمبراطور

paragraph: Both of my parents don't know how to **swim**. We used to **swim** in this river a lot. Let us try to **swim** against the current.
english: act or instance of swimming
arabicDesc: مثال: كلا والداي لا يعرفان كيف يسبحان

paragraph: This **chick** is out all the time, she's never home. There was only one **chick** in the nest. How did it go with the **chick**?
english: a young bird
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: رأل

other.meaning: young chicken
young woman

paragraph: I'm looking for an easy way to **supplement** my income. You had better **supplement** your diet with vitamins. What sort of independent study should I do to **supplement** classes?
english: something added

other.meaning: vitamin, herbal extract, or chemical compound — see also dietary supplement

paragraph: The national park has many beautiful places to **hike**. We took a long **hike** up to the summit. Were it clear, we would go on a **hike**.
english: a long walk in nature; a sudden increase

paragraph: Three years ago, that was just a **conspiracy** theory. The ridiculous **conspiracy** theories seem to be coming true. I think almost all of them joined the **conspiracy**.
english: an agreement or arrangement between multiple parties to do something harmful, immoral or subversive

other.meaning: act of working in secret to obtain some goal

paragraph: She advised him to go on a **strict** diet. My dad is very **strict**. The art teacher was **strict**.
english: governed or governing by exact rules
arabicDesc: مثال: نَصَحَتهُ أَن يَقومَ بِنِظامٍ غِذائيٍ صارِم

paragraph: I couldn't resist having a second **slice** of cake. Try to **slice** the meat with a different knife. I cut a **slice** of cake for each guest.
english: that which is thin and broad

other.meaning: To cut into slices (verb)

paragraph: He might see you as a **competitor**. She's a tough **competitor**, isn't she? I know you're working for one of our **competitors**.
english: a person or organization against whom one is competing

paragraph: I'll only buy the car if they fix the **brakes** first. Did you know that your **brake** lights are out? He put his foot on the **brake** suddenly.
english: an ancient engine of war analogous to the crossbow and ballista
arabicDesc: مثال: سأشتري السيارة بشرط أن يصلحوا المكابح أولاً.

other.meaning: To operate a brake or brakes (verb)
To bruise and crush (verb)

paragraph: Don't place heavy objects on top of the **tablet**. You need to keep your **tablet** away from liquids. The new **tablet** costs an arm and a leg.
english: a slab of clay, stone or wood used for inscription

paragraph: The average life **span** of a dog is 10 years. This spider can have a leg **span** of up 6 inches. A decade is a **span** of ten years.
english: the full width of an open hand from the end of the thumb to the end of the little finger used as an informal unit of length

paragraph: You have to have a piece of **pie**. It's as easy as **pie**. I baked an apple **pie**.
english: type of pastry
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب أن يكون لديك قطعة فطيرة.

paragraph: That **ingredient** seems to me to spoil the taste. Data is a vital **ingredient** of training machine learning models. This **ingredient** is used in traditional Chinese medicine.
english: one of the substances present in a mixture, especially food

paragraph: Someone needs to take the **bin** out. He threw a lot of letters in the **bin**. Put trash in the **bin**, not on your desk.
english: a box, frame, crib, or enclosed place, used as a storage container
arabicDesc: مثال: يحتاج أحدهم إلى أخذ القمامة خارجًا.

paragraph: You must **activate** the software before you can use it again. If you want to **activate** my mean side, just go on. You can **activate** the lower trap with an over-the-shoulder bar raise.
english: to encourage development or induce increased activity

paragraph: **Laser** surgery can fix some kinds of vision problems. **Laser** rays are used in the restoration of ancient works. Don't point the **laser** at my face!
english: a device that produces a monochromatic, coherent beam of light

paragraph: I wrote the phone number on the writing **pad**. Can I crash at your **pad** for a bit? The rocket landed successfully on the launch **pad**.
english: a soft piece of material; a block of paper

paragraph: By some **miracle**, the bus came on time. Love is the **miracle** of civilization. **Miracles** are called **miracles** because they don't happen!
english: wonderful event attributed to supernatural powers
arabicDesc: مثال: حدثت معجزة و وصلت الحافلة في الوقت.

paragraph: Even if my memories **fade**, my records will remain. Flowers soon **fade** when they have been cut. The color won't **fade**, even in the wash.
english: to slowly become less bright or strong

paragraph: Silence **reigned** in the forest. Nothing will change for the better under their **reign**. He began to **reign** at the age of forty.
english: the exercise of sovereign power
arabicDesc: مثال: ساد الصمت في الغابة.

other.meaning: To exercise sovereign power, to rule as a monarch (verb)

paragraph: He **emphasized** the importance of peace. I was born to **emphasize** my difference from most people. Chinese doesn't **emphasize** words in the same way as English.
english: to stress, give emphasis or extra weight to (something)
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد ألح على أهمية السلم.

paragraph: What is the **motivation** for you to drink water? I haven't felt the **motivation** to do anything lately. Do you know how to write letters of **motivation**?
english: willingness of action especially in behavior

paragraph: It is much better to be healthy than **wealthy**. He is **wealthy** in appearance but not in reality. I'm not **wealthy**, but I do have my health.
english: possessing financial wealth

paragraph: **Insert** this memory stick into my head, please! To continue, please **insert** the disc labelled Disc 2. Do I have to **insert** coins first?
english: to put in between or into

paragraph: The sheep **retreated** to the shelter. He decided neither to advance nor to **retreat**. They had no alternative but to **retreat**.
english: the act of pulling back or withdrawing, as from something dangerous, or unpleasant
arabicDesc: مثال: ذهبت الكباش إلى المأوى.

other.meaning: To withdraw from a position, go back (verb)

paragraph: The crown prince is the one who is to succeed to the **throne**. Game of **Thrones** is my favorite series. Under no circumstances will the princess succeed to the **throne**.
english: ornate seat
arabicDesc: مثال: ولي العهد هو من يرث العرش.

paragraph: I always carry a bottle of **mineral** water with me. I will have **mineral** water. Do you sell **mineral** water?
english: in geology
arabicDesc: مثال: أحمل معي قنينة مياه معدنيّة دومًا.

paragraph: He crushed the insect with his **heel**. The strict rules aim to bring everyone to **heel**. When she cried, he felt like a **heel**.
english: the rear part of the foot, where it joins the leg
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد سحق تلك الحشرة بكعبه.

paragraph: The **patrol** cars cover the whole of the area. The security guard went back on his normal **patrol**. He did the **patrol** at two in the morning.
english: a movement, by a small body of troops beyond the line of outposts, to explore the country and gain intelligence of the enemy's whereabouts
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: خفر

other.meaning: movement by a small body of troops beyond the line of outposts

paragraph: The tree you saw was not an **oak** tree. This is Professor **Oak**, the director of this experiment. The old **oak** was almost higher than the house.
english: any member of species of the genus Quercus, in family Fagaceae
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: بلوط

other.meaning: tree or shrub of the genus Quercus

paragraph: We are looking for a house with a **garage**. Can you keep the car in the **garage**? I am painting my **garage**.
english: building or section of building to store a car, tools etc.
arabicDesc: مثال: إننا نبحث عن منزل يضم مرآباً.

other.meaning: place where cars are serviced and repaired

paragraph: You should **boil** this water before you drink it. The water will come to a **boil** in 5 minutes or so. **Boil** down the report to one page.
english: point at which fluid begins to change to a vapour
arabicDesc: مثال: ينبغي أن تغلّي هذا الماء قبل شربِه.

other.meaning: To heat to the point where it begins to turn into a gas (verb)

paragraph: You are a professional, but I am an **amateur**. I was still an **amateur** at that time. She gave an **amateur** performance on the piano.
english: someone who is unqualified or insufficiently skillful
arabicDesc: مثال: إنك محترف وأنا مبتدئ.

paragraph: I could feel the **bass** in my chest. Are you happy with your new **bass** guitar? A cat was sleeping in the **bass** drum.
english: a low spectrum of sound tones

paragraph: The first minutes after a heart attack are **crucial**. The computer plays a **crucial** role in our existence. I believe love is a **crucial** part of life.
english: essential or decisive for determining the outcome or future of something

paragraph: She applied for the **dual** credit program at her local university. He has a **dual** personality. I want my children to have **dual** citizenship.
english: characterized by having two (usually equivalent) components

other.meaning: Of an item that is one of a pair, the other item in the pair (noun)

paragraph: Our **experimental** results left something to be desired. I'm going to analyze the **experimental** results, and write a report. The soldiers were administered an **experimental** vaccine.
english: based on new ideas or tests

paragraph: A purple boat was arriving, drifting in the **gulf**. Oil leaked into the **Gulf** for 87 days. There is a **gulf** between our opinions.
english: a hollow place in the earth

other.meaning: The Persian Gulf, or the region surrounding it (noun)

paragraph: I'm afraid the **odds** will go down a bit. The **odds** of this team winning are next to none. Your words are at **odds** with your actions.
english: the chance that something will happen

paragraph: Country life is very **peaceful** in comparison with city life. Everyone has the right to freedom of **peaceful** assembly and association. We don't want a **peaceful** solution.
english: not at war or disturbed by strife or turmoil
arabicDesc: مثال: الحياة الريفية هي الأكثر هدوءًً مقارنةً بحياة المدينة.

other.meaning: inclined to peace; peaceable

paragraph: They participated in the national crime **prevention** initiative. **Prevention** is always the best solution. **Prevention** is better than a cure.
english: the act of preventing or hindering

paragraph: The following data has been made **publicly** available. Be careful what you say **publicly**. It may have consequences. I want to **publicly** complain about that.
english: in public, openly, in an open and public manner
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: علنا

paragraph: **Revenge** is the only thing that keeps me alive. **Revenge** is a dish which is best served cold. The officer seemed to be afraid of their **revenge**.
english: any form of personal, retaliatory action against an individual, institution, or group for some alleged or perceived harm or injustice
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: انتقام

other.meaning: To take revenge for (a particular harmful action) or on behalf of (its victim) (verb)

paragraph: It is **surprising** that you should know her name. If he comes at all, it will be **surprising**. I don't know why you find that so **surprising**.
english: unexpected

paragraph: **Tourism** is important to the economy of my country. For **tourism**, the dry season with little rain is ideal. **Tourism** from specialized cruise ships is increasing rapidly.
english: the act of travelling or sightseeing, particularly away from one's home

paragraph: You must **fulfill** your duty. Today, my greatest wish was **fulfilled**. You are here in order to **fulfill** my commands.
english: to carry out — see also carry out, realize
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك أن تقوم بواجبك.

paragraph: I may have been brave, but he was **bold**. It is **bold** of you to question her proposal. It is **bold** of him to refuse our offer.
english: courageous
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: جسور

paragraph: Money is not a **criterion** of success. This is a secondary **criterion**. What **criterion** did you use when you elected this essay as the winner?
english: a standard, test, or requirement by which individual things or people may be compared and judged

paragraph: This man is a **merchant**. The **merchant** gave a great discount on the price. I gave my old bike to the scrap **merchant**.
english: person who traffics in commodities
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا الرجل تاجر.

paragraph: Last year, there was a bad **harvest**. Who seeds wind, shall **harvest** storm. The **harvest** was poor due to lack of water.
english: to bring in a harvest; reap
arabicDesc: مثال: كان محصول العام الماضي سيئا.

paragraph: The real **terror** began about a week after that. They think that Islam is a religion of **terror**. What I feel, just thinking about it, is **terror**.
english: intense dread, fright, or fear
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: هول، ذعر، خوف

other.meaning: action or quality of causing dread
terrorism

paragraph: There is a **suspension** bridge ahead of us. The student was given a three day **suspension**. A temporary **suspension** has been imposed on discussion of this subject.
english: the act of suspending, or the state of being suspended

other.meaning: temporary or conditional delay, interruption or discontinuation

paragraph: Excuse me, do you know what is the weather **forecast** for tomorrow? What is the weather **forecast**? **Forecasting** is the way of saying what will happen and then explaining why it didn't.
english: estimation of future condition
arabicDesc: مثال: لو سمحت، هل تعلم ما هي توقعات الطقس ليوم غد؟

paragraph: Do you want some **whip** cream on your pie? I'm sure you'll **whip** us up something really good. The cruel man beat the dog with a **whip**.
english: a lash
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: كرباج

other.meaning: To hit with a whip (verb)

paragraph: Nothing could **induce** him to change his mind. Moderate exercise in the evening helps **induce** sleep. That music is anxiety-**inducing**.
english: to lead by persuasion or influence
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: حث

paragraph: I work as a web **consultant** on the side. Don't worry, I also happen to be a financial **consultant**. Where can I find a good financial **consultant**?
english: a person whose occupation is to be consulted for their expertise, advice, service or help in an area or specialty
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مستشارة

paragraph: We don't have enough elements to understand the **phenomenon**. More information is needed to recognize an unexpected **phenomenon**. Together we'll analyse the **phenomenon** of violence against women.
english: a thing or being, event or process, perceptible through senses

paragraph: The world **premiere** is tonight. The film **premieres** on Monday. The queue for the theme park attraction was shorter than for the movie **premiere**.
english: the first showing of a film, play or other form of entertainment, often held as a special event with celebrity guests

paragraph: This is a **breach** of diplomatic protocol. That would be a **breach** of contract. If you do that, I'll sue you for **breach** of contract!
english: break of a law or obligation
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا خرق للبروتوكول الدبلوماسي.

paragraph: Pass me the salt and **pepper**, please. You put in too much **pepper**. Do you want some **pepper**?
english: a plant of the family Piperaceae
arabicDesc: مثال: من فضلك مرر إليّ الملح و الفلفل.

paragraph: Have you ever bought cookies from a Girl **Scout**? The captain decided to send out a **scout**. The Boy **Scout** has been directing old ladies across streets since 2004.
english: a person sent out to gather and bring back information

paragraph: The Communist Party of the Russian **Federation** remains powerful. This morning I spoke with the **federation** president. I want to move to the United **Federation** of Planets.
english: an act of joining together into a single political entity
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: فدرالية

paragraph: I **deem** him capable of anything. She **deems** this can be understood without a translation. The boy **deemed** that he cheated in the examination.
english: to hold in belief or estimation

paragraph: Hey, look, a three-headed **monkey**! The **monkey** climbed up a tree. The **monkey** is in the tree.
english: any simian, including humans
arabicDesc: مثال: انظر ، هناك قرد بثلاث رؤوس!

paragraph: Our age goes in for **quantity** regardless of quality. Both **quantity** and quality are important in most cases. What is more important to you? **Quantity** or quality?
english: an indefinite amount of something
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مقدار، قدر

paragraph: Part of this **conviction** is rooted in my own experience. An opinion is shocking only if it is a **conviction**. Belief is not a matter of choice, but of **conviction**.
english: firmly held belief
arabicDesc: مثال: يعود جزء من اعتقادي هذا إلى تجربتي الشخصية.

paragraph: If you are a man, **behave** as such. My mother told me I have to **behave** myself. I don't need you telling me how to **behave**.
english: to act in a specific manner
arabicDesc: مثال: إن كنتَ رجلا، فتصرف مثل الرجال.

other.meaning: to act in a polite or proper way

paragraph: The prime minister can **initiate** a vote of confidence. You will be **initiating** the discussion for this activity. She never **initiates** conversations with strangers.
english: to begin

other.meaning: A new member of an organization (noun)

paragraph: I couldn't improve my performance in the last **evaluation**. I want a full **evaluation** as soon as possible. The **evaluation** could take months.
english: a completion of a mathematical operation
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: تقدير

paragraph: She **stabbed** her husband repeatedly. Even a small needle can **stab** through a heart. I would never **stab** you in the back.
english: act of stabbing
arabicDesc: مثال: طعنت زوجها عدة مرات.

other.meaning: wound made by stabbing
To pierce or to wound (somebody) with a (usually pointed) tool or weapon, especially a knife or dagger (verb)

paragraph: He tried to **certify** the matter as correct. What's the difference between regular mail and **certified** mail? He was a **certified** history teacher.
english: to state officially that something is true

paragraph: See how high you can make the ball **bounce**. Can the economy **bounce** back after the crisis? How did you **bounce** back from that?
english: to spring back after hitting something

paragraph: Almost all of the pupils were in the **classroom**. The high school students are studying in the **classroom**. There were few students left in the **classroom**.
english: room in a school
arabicDesc: مثال: كل التلاميذ تقريبا كانوا في القسم.

paragraph: Her eldest son will serve as the **administrator** of the estate. **Administrators** need to build close contact with employees. I transmitted a message to the school **administrator**.
english: one who administers affairs
arabicDesc: مثال: إبنها الأكبر سيخدم مسؤلاً عن المؤسسة.

paragraph: Nothing is written on the **helicopter**. I have a friend who can fly a **helicopter**. It was the first time I boarded a **helicopter**.
english: a powered troweling machine with spinning blades used to spread concrete
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يكتب شيء على المروحية.

paragraph: He says he's ready to **gamble** with his life. Man, giving her this ring is a huge **gamble**. Trusting him is a **gamble** at best.
english: a bet or wager

other.meaning: To take a risk, with the potential of a positive outcome (verb)

paragraph: **Transformation** is birth and death at the same time. I'm ready for a **transformation** in my life. Butterflies undergo a complete **transformation** during their lifetimes.
english: the act of transforming or the state of being transformed

paragraph: Can you **interact** with others in a mature way? Her dog walks create opportunities to **interact** with people. We encourage our residents to **interact** with each other.
english: to communicate or work with others

paragraph: Don't forget to remind me to **renew** my passport. How often do pilots have to **renew** their licenses? It's critical to understand how to **renew** the connection.
english: to make new again
arabicDesc: مثال: ذكّرني كي أجدّد جواز سفري.

paragraph: The judge **condemned** him to death. Well, what can we do? Just **condemn** in silence. Would you **condemn** your friend for the same thing?
english: to say strongly that something is wrong
arabicDesc: مثال: حكم عليه القاضي بالإعدام.

paragraph: An agreement **acceptable** to all parties was finally reached. Let's find a solution that is **acceptable** to everyone. It is sometimes **acceptable** to resort to violence.
english: good enough; allowed

paragraph: **Chaos** cries for order and order cries for **chaos**. They worked together to restore order after the **chaos**. They spread disorder until the country fell into **chaos**.
english: the unordered state of matter in classical accounts of cosmogony

paragraph: Gold, silver, **copper**, and iron are widely used metals. The seller weighs the cheese on the **copper** scales. Now I am starting to issue **copper** medals.
english: a reddish-brown metallic chemical element (symbol Cu) with the atomic number 29

paragraph: Yesterday morning, the President welcomed the press **corps**. I served in the intelligence **corps**. He belongs to the diplomatic **corps**.
english: a battlefield formation composed of two or more divisions

paragraph: Our **earnings** are in proportion to our real ability. Corporate **earnings** for the first quarter were disappointing. How bad do you think third quarter **earnings** will be?
english: money earned

paragraph: That's scary and **hilarious** at the same time. Speech recognition software can make **hilarious** errors. This movie is so terrible it's **hilarious**.
english: very funny
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مضحك

paragraph: This **psychological** study investigates the cognitive factors of memory. Those selected will have to face extensive medical and **psychological** tests. His memory loss is more a **psychological** than a physical trouble.
english: relating to the mind

paragraph: How much **radiation** are we absorbing every day? An adult female patient is being readied for **radiation** therapy. He was exposed to dangerous levels of **radiation**.
english: the shooting forth of anything from a point or surface, like diverging rays of light

paragraph: I take my camera with me **wherever** I go. His wife goes with him **wherever** he goes. **Wherever** you go, you'll find Japanese tourists.
english: in any place, anywhere
arabicDesc: مثال: آخذ آلة التصوير معي أينما ذهبت.

paragraph: Only an artist can **interpret** the meaning of life. How do you **interpret** these lines of the poem? It's alright to **interpret** things in your own way.
english: to explain or tell the meaning of
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أول
